verdict.rationale: Beamer documents installation via a simple embed code. It also documents an in-app widget that collects user comments and reactions, plus an in-app NPS survey, so the core of a script-embedded feedback-capable widget is present. However, the widget is primarily a changelog/announcement widget. The evidence never states that the embed is a single script tag or that no build step is required. missing for 10: explicit single-script-tag install snippet, explicit no-build-step confirmation, documentation of a dedicated general-purpose feedback widget (vs. changelog reactions/NPS), independent or hands-on corroboration of the embed process.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed a feedback widget on my website with a single script tag and no build step

citations.quote: with a simple embed code or Wordpress plugin.
